title: Google Debuting a Bank-Grade Crypto Custody Tool Built on Split Keys: Report
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Google Debuting a Bank-Grade Crypto Custody Tool Built on Split Keys: Report Google is previewing a crypto custody system that splits private keys across separate environments, with several banks testing it ahead of a planned early 2027 launch. This post Google Debuting a Bank-Grade Crypto Custody Tool Built on Split Keys: Report first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
